$comment: Production dependencies whose licence is outside the allow-list in tooling/check-licenses.mjs. Every entry needs a reviewed rationale (ADR 0009). `name` may end in `*` to cover platform packages.

exceptions.name: caniuse-lite
exceptions.rationale: Browserslist data used by Next.js at build time only; never shipped in the client bundle. Attribution is kept in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt.

exceptions.name: lightningcss
exceptions.rationale: CSS transformer inside Tailwind 4, used unmodified at build time; MPL-2.0 is file-level copyleft and imposes nothing on our code.

exceptions.name: lightningcss-*
exceptions.rationale: Platform binaries of lightningcss (see above), installed per OS/CPU.

exceptions.name: robust-predicates
exceptions.rationale: Shewchuk's exact orient2d/orient3d predicates for Multi-Cut chords and concave tests in mesh-core (M6A-SPEC §2, Q-MOD-K-6). The Unlicense is a public-domain dedication, OSI-approved; it imposes no conditions on our code or on redistribution. Reviewed for M6a by the integration agent; fallback if a reviewer rejects it: port the four predicates into mesh-core/src/predicates (B1).
